snippet.title: Version 4.4 Trailer: "In Ravages Does the Whistle Sound" | Honkai: Star Rail
snippet.description:
The Navigator charts a course to the apocalypse. A mournful whistle howls, and only those of the Trailblaze can find a path to survival across the realm of death...
※ This video contains content in development. Please refer to the official launch version for final content.

※ Special Note: The in-game voice-over language for the collaboration character is only available in Japanese, Chinese, and Korean. You can switch to other voice-over languages in-game, or navigate to Character Details → Information → Voice to individually switch the collaboration character's interaction, combat, and idle voices to the Fate[UBW] original licensed voice-over (Japanese).

English Voice:
Asat Pramad — Joe Hernandez
Sunday — Griffin Puatu
Dan Heng — Nicholas Leung
March 7th — Skyler Davenport
Himeko/Motoko — Cia Court
Starblazer — Nic Olsen
Female Trailblazer — Chloe Eves
